title: RE: FW: Security questionnaire discrepancy - Brazos Freight / Routewell

messages.author: Dana Whitlock <dwhitlock@brazosfreight.example>
messages.body:
Jordan,

During final review our team compared your completed security questionnaire against the trust page on your website. Question 14 on the questionnaire states Routewell holds a current SOC 2 Type II report. Your trust page states a Type I report was issued in April and a Type II audit is "in progress."

These are not the same thing, and our vendor policy requires Type II for any system touching driver PII. Until this is resolved I have asked our legal team to hold the order form. They would like a call this week with someone from your security team who can speak to the actual status and timeline.

Please let me know availability.

Dana Whitlock
Director, IT Security & Compliance
Brazos Freight Partners

messages.author: Greg Halvorsen <greg.halvorsen@routewell.example>
messages.body:
Jordan - forwarding so Priya sees this. This deal is in my commit for Q4 and I already told Lauren it was closing next week. Who filled out Q14? I need to understand how this happened and what the plan is before my 4pm. Don't reply to Dana until we've talked.

G

messages.author: Priya Menon <priya.menon@routewell.example>
messages.body:
Jordan,

That was me. I pulled the answers from the questionnaire library and I didn't catch that Q14 was still the old draft language from when we thought the Type II would be done in the summer. I should have checked it against the trust page and I didn't. I'm so sorry. I know how long you've worked on Brazos and I know what this deal means for your number.

If you need to tell Greg it was me, please do, I'm not going to make you cover for me. I'll do whatever I can to fix it. I can draft a corrected questionnaire tonight.

Priya
